item.title: Asialink - Inspirational Speaker Philippines - Francis Kong
item.description: Had a wonderful afternoon with the entrepreneurs and leaders of Asialink at their Business Summit. I truly enjoyed the event and learned a great deal from the resource speakers as well. Thank you for having me.

item.title: A Blessed Sunday - Inspirational Speaker Philippines - Francis Kong
item.description: SUNDAY MEDITATION: We can have success and still feel empty. We can have people around us and still feel alone. But there is a place in our soul that only Jesus can fill. And when He fills it, there will be peace that goes beyond understanding. Have a Blessed Sunday!

item.title: A Productive Week Ahead - Inspirational Speaker Philippines - Francis Kong
item.description: These are challenging times. Costs are rising, the future feels uncertain, and many are doing their best just to keep their footing. But let us remember: pressure does not have to break us. It can also build us. Allow this season to teach us to think clearly, work faithfully, live simply, relate with others peacefully […]

item.title: NOT ENEMIES - Inspirational Speaker Philippines - Francis Kong
item.description: Stubbornness and flexibility are not enemies. They answer different signals. Be unbending when the pressure comes from ego, trends, or noise. Be quick to bend when truth, evidence, and better information arrive. Resilience without adaptability becomes rigidity. Adaptability without conviction becomes aimlessness. Wisdom is knowing when to stand firm and when to change course. #PassionPurposeProductivity
